question: A factory tracked morning, afternoon, and evening with word quantities. Starting with 107 units, morning shift multiplied by 6 (642 units). Afternoon boost added 71 (713 units). Production scaled by 8 (5704 units). Major maintenance removed 3299 (2405 units). Recovery repairs added 26 (2431 units). Evening doubling for next day preparation (4862 units). A competing factory had 300 units. What was the evening prep amount?

On Monday morning a mill ran 9 looms, and each loom wove 107 metres of ribbon. Before lunch a supplier delivered another 27 metres of the same ribbon. In the afternoon every metre in the mill was cut into 6 short strips. A worker found 36 more strips left over from Friday and added them to the pile. That evening a shop bought 848 strips, and a wholesaler collected another 1190. How many strips were left in the pile?

A charity fun run had 210 runners registered in each of its 4 age groups. On the day, 73 more runners signed up at the desk. A dozen volunteers handed out water along the route, which was 10 kilometres long. Every runner who took part raised 5 dollars for the charity. After the run, three local shops donated 45 dollars, 35 dollars, and 53 dollars. How many dollars did the charity receive in total?

The theater sold 165 tickets for the first showing, which sold out in 90 minutes, or 1.5 hours. Five sister theaters each matched that sales count exactly, making the citywide total six times as large. The distributor then split that total evenly across 3 regions, and only the downtown region's share was kept. That regional total was then split evenly between 2 theaters, and only one theater's share counted. Finally, a second matching theater doubled that theater's ticket count. How many tickets did that theater end up with?

On Monday morning a leisure centre had 151 lockers in use by its members. During the morning 23 of them were emptied and closed. In the afternoon 18 new members took lockers of their own, and in the early evening a further 5 were taken. That night the caretaker stuck 6 fresh labels on every locker that was in use. How many labels did the caretaker use?

A store started with 213 items. They multiplied by 2 through reordering. They divided by 3 for three locations. They added 45 items from new stock. They added 4 items from special orders (measured in location-distributed items). Her friend shopped 8 items separately. What was the item count per location?

A party shop had 105 packets of balloons on the shelf. 76 packets were bought for a wedding, and 2 more were ruined by a leak in the roof. Each packet still on the shelf contains 8 balloons, and the owner emptied them all into one bin. A supplier dropped 14 loose balloons into the same bin. A children's party then used 97 balloons from the bin. The shop has 3 other branches. How many balloons are left in the bin?

A coach analyzed statistics. He started tracking 35 players. He added 68 new participants. He subtracted 96 for a graduating class. He added 65 players in a merger. He subtracted 64 for transfers out. Then multiplied by 7 for season planning. One distractor: the previous year had 50 players. How many player-slots are in the season plan?

On Tuesday morning a toy factory moulded 197 trays, and each tray held 8 figures. By the afternoon every figure had been packed with 5 accessories. In the evening a supplier sent 18 accessories, and a returned order added 47 more. Half of the factory floor is used for storage, and the firm employs 210 people. How many accessories are there now?
A schedule had 160 minutes. Removed 90. Multiplied by 6. Divided by 6. Added 39. Removed 96. Multiplied by 7. Converting to hours, how much?

Ines had 182 photographs in her shoebox before the exhibition. She had 45 more prints made and dropped them into the same box. She gave 141 of the photographs to the families who appear in them, and 8 more were spoiled when a window was left open in the rain. She spread what remained equally across 6 display boards, then hung only one of those boards in the hall and stored the rest. A dozen visitors came to the opening. Every photograph on the hall board was held up with 8 brass tacks. How many tacks were used on the hall board?

Ada had 157 tiles, used 140 on the floor, and broke 13, though a dozen helpers had offered to carry them. She cut each remaining tile into 8 strips and each strip into 4 pieces for the mosaic tray. She used 29 pieces on the border. How many pieces are in the mosaic tray?
Two players had 77 marbles. Player B removed 2. Player B added 36. Player B added 5 more. Player B removed 32. Player B divided by 6 for tournament rounds. How many marbles per round?

Mr. Okafor counted 193 sticker sheets in the supply cupboard and threw out 4 that were water-damaged. He split the rest equally between 3 classes, so each class received the same number of sheets. Ms. Bell's class, which received exactly as many as the others, then gave 20 of its sheets to the nursery. Every sheet still with Ms. Bell's class is printed with 6 rows, and each row holds 5 stickers. The same cupboard also contains 84 spare rulers. How many stickers does Ms. Bell's class have?

A garden started with 63 plants. They multiplied the count by 7 after spring growth. They removed 322 plants during a renovation. They removed another 94 plants that died. They added 77 new plants from a nursery. They added 53 more flowering plants. They added 63 vegetable seedlings. How many plants were in the final garden?

A vineyard is planted with 214 vines in every row, 8 rows in every block, and 9 blocks across the estate. The owner, who has run the vineyard for a dozen years, also planted 30 vines along the driveway, 61 vines around the house, and 7 vines by the gate. How many vines are there on the estate?

A store manager tracked sales throughout the day. Starting with 115 items, 55 were sold by mid-morning (60 items). A restock added 57 items (117 items). By noon, 23 were sold (94 items). Afternoon brought 62 new items (156 items). Late afternoon added 35 more items (191 items). Evening closing removed 74 items from active display. Converting to dozens, this represented about 9.75 dozen items. How many items remained?

A business started with 87 transactions in the morning. By midday, they added 51 more transactions, reaching 138. In the afternoon, they added 45 additional, reaching 183. They multiplied by 4 to extrapolate volume to 732 transactions. They experienced 590 failed transactions, leaving 142 successful. They multiplied the successful transactions 6 times for annual projection to 852. They removed 112 from adjustments. His store processes 1,000 transactions daily (separate). How many transactions are projected?

Two participants competed. Starting with 49 points, qualifying round multiplied by 3 (147 points). Tiebreaker removed 99 (48 points). Sudden death multiplied by 5 (240 points). Comeback bonus added 77 (317 points). Final surge added 67 points. Marcus scored 125 in parallel brackets. What was the final score?

Rosa knitted 39 hats for the winter fair, and her friend Jonah knitted 44, so Jonah made more hats than Rosa did. They bought 9 beads to decorate every hat. A box was dropped on the stairs and 130 of the beads were lost. A craft shop donated 44 beads, and a school sent another 42. The village hall costs 15 pounds an hour to hire. How many beads do they have now?

A contractor had 103 supplies initially. He multiplied by 7 for a large project. He added 71 more from inventory. He removed 565 damaged items. He removed 148 for another job. He added 8 from salvage. The company had 10 worksites. How many supplies remaining?

Two friends, Petra and Sam, keep separate coin jars, but this story follows only Petra's jar, which started at 13 dollars, less than Sam's jar held. She spent 2 dollars on stickers. A birthday gift added 57 dollars to her jar. She then spent 12 dollars on a book. Finally, she spent 9 more dollars on a movie ticket, around the same week her friend mentioned saving about a dozen bottle caps, unrelated to the money count. How much money was in Petra's jar in the end?

Zoe walks dogs for 25 dollars a walk. She does 7 walks each week and worked for 5 weeks. She usually walks 4 dogs at a time. A grateful owner gave her a 55-dollar bonus. Her booking app reports earnings in cents, so Zoe converted the amount to dollars before paying her bills. She then paid 560 dollars in rent and 246 dollars for leads and treats. How many dollars did Zoe have left?

A school's rock collection display starts the semester with 20 rocks. A field trip haul brings the display's count to 6 times what it was. The rocks are then split evenly across 5 display cases, and the story follows just one case's rocks from here. The school's mineral collection down the hall, separately, has 200 specimens, unrelated to this display. That case then gains 33 more rocks from a student donation. A parent volunteer adds 3 more rocks found on a hike. A final addition of 4 rocks comes from a retiring teacher's old collection, weighing in at just under 2 kilograms combined, or about 4.4 pounds. How many rocks are in that one display case now?

In the morning, a bookstore had 189 paperback novels on the clearance table. By midday, 146 novels were sold during a big sale. In the afternoon, a dozen more novels were donated to a local shelter and removed from the table. That evening, the remaining novels doubled when a publisher sent a matching donation. Right before closing, a final donation turned every novel into 4 novels. How many novels were on the clearance table after the final donation?
